module: Registry of the router's navigation guards. reloadGuards scans the lua/ge/extensions/ui/router/guards/ folder, loads each file and registers the functions of its M.guards table under their key. Routes reference these keys in their guard lists (enterGuards, exitGuards); executeGuards runs them in order. A modder can add their own guards with addGuard.
notes: A guard is called with (route, params, context); only the exact value false blocks (result.failedGuard = guard key): a nil return lets it through. Unknown guard keys are ignored with a warning.
addGuard does not overwrite an existing key (warning); updateGuard requires it to exist.

Guards are loaded with require("ge/extensions/ui/router/guards/<file>") after FS:findFiles("/lua/ge/extensions/ui/router/guards/", "*.lua"): a file in this folder without an M.guards table is loaded but provides nothing (case of guards/default.lua).

reloadGuards.desc: Empties the registry then reloads all guards from the files of the guards/ folder. Called when ui_router loads.

addGuard.desc: Adds a guard under the given key; does nothing (warning) if the key already exists.

updateGuard.desc: Replaces an existing guard; does nothing (warning) if the key is unknown.

removeGuard.desc: Removes the guard with the given key.

executeGuards.desc: Runs the listed guards in order; stops at the first one that returns false.

specifiedGuards.desc: Keys of the guards to run.

route.desc: Target route (or the current route for exit guards).

context.desc: Context (for example {routeName, options} for exit guards).

returns.desc: {result = value of the last guard run (true by default), failedGuard = key of the blocking guard}.
